ROLE: Researcher (read-only investigation). You are the fact-finder for run `2026-11-08-design-and-remediation`. I am the orchestrator/Project Manager; I own state.json, acceptance.json, PLAN.md, PROGRESS.md, DECISIONS.md and all merges. You own facts only.

OBJECTIVE
Establish, with command evidence, whether this run can actually execute its 99 frozen acceptance gates in the current environment, and precisely what is blocked. Wave A dispatch and the G0 baseline both depend on your findings, so accuracy matters more than speed.

CONTEXT YOU NEED
- Repo: C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha, current branch `dev`.
- Planner commit 0772d502002562505c6438ae712abca7a7328d84; branch `run/2026-11-08/integration` points at it. That is the base for every packet.
- Evidence dir (gitignored): bridge-io/policy/2026-11-08-design-and-remediation/ containing state.json (schema warsha-run/v1, phase `plan`, seq 2, 7 packets W1..W7), acceptance.json (all gates `not-run`), checkpoints/001-intake.json + 002-plan.json, packets/W1..W7/prompt.md, HANDOVER.md.
- Read AGENTS.md and ENGINEERING_POLICY.md first. Gates are FROZEN at plan time: never edit, narrow, re-word or skip a gate. Never update `*-snapshots/**`.
- Wave A = W1 (readme-truth), W3 (ui-v2), W4 (wire-client-harness), W6 (pipeline-hardening), W7 (android-apk). Wave B = W2, W5 after checkpoint C1.
- Gate `host` tags in state.json are `worktree`, `linux-capture-host`, and Windows-host for integration gates.

QUESTIONS TO ANSWER (each with the command you ran and its real output)
1. LINUX CAPTURE HOST. Is a Linux capture environment reachable from this machine right now? Check WSL availability, installed distros, and which user it runs as. Prior project notes claimed the WSL capture path is root-only and needed an ext4 clone - VERIFY the current reality, do not assume it. Find the repo's own documented capture procedure: scripts/ci/install-capture-fonts.sh, the fontconfig pin, playwright.config.* projects `desktop` and `remote`, the CI workflow that runs them, and any PROGRESS.md/DECISIONS.md entry about the 120 Linux visual baselines. Report the EXACT command sequence to run `pnpm exec playwright test --project=desktop --reporter=line` and `--project=remote` on Linux at commit 0772d50 with pinned IBM Plex, including where the checkout must live (ext4 vs /mnt/c) and whether such a clone already exists and at what commit.
2. TOOLCHAIN. Actual versions of node, pnpm, cargo, rustc. Is node_modules installed in the main checkout, and is the pnpm workspace linked? Is there a cargo target cache? For W7 also: Java/JDK, Gradle, Android SDK/NDK, and any tauri android prerequisites - present or absent.
3. W7 SIGNING MATERIAL. Read packets/W7/prompt.md and report exactly which owner-scoped signing material it requires (env var names, keystore file path, alias). Report PRESENCE ONLY for each - boolean plus the path/variable name. Never print, echo, cat, copy or log any secret value, password, or keystore content. If any required item is absent, say so plainly: W7 becomes `blocked` (out-of-scope), it is never faked.
4. PER-PACKET GATE INVENTORY. For W1, W3, W4, W6, W7: from state.json plan.packets[i].acceptance_gates plus packets/WN/prompt.md, list gate ids grouped by host tag, and the packet's allowed_files and branch/worktree path. Flag any gate whose command appears unrunnable as written (missing script file, non-existent pnpm filter target, tool not installed). Report the flag - do NOT fix or reinterpret the gate.
5. A11Y COUNT DISCREPANCY. The plan lists desktop 793 = a11y 188 + states 252 + visual 308 + flows 30 + layout 12 + onboarding 3, but the owner brief flags a possible 180-vs-188 a11y discrepancy. Determine the real current a11y test count and the desktop/remote listed totals. Prefer `pnpm exec playwright test --project=desktop --list` (listing needs no browser); if that cannot run, count from the spec files and say which method you used. Give exact numbers and the file/command that is the source of truth.
6. WORKTREE FEASIBILITY. Does C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/warsha-wt/ exist, are there existing git worktrees (`git worktree list`), is there free disk space for 5 simultaneous worktrees plus installs, and is `git worktree add` from run/2026-11-08/integration viable? Note: this repo has Git content filters configured and a shell shim that can misreport `git status` cleanliness - do not trust a bare "clean" claim; use explicit git commands and say what you actually observed.

NON-GOALS (do not do these)
- No code, doc, config or gate edits. No dependency installs that would change package.json/lockfiles.
- No commits, merges, pushes, publishes, releases, or destructive git operations.
- No writes to state.json, acceptance.json, checkpoints/, PLAN.md, PROGRESS.md, DECISIONS.md - I own those.
- Do NOT run the full G0 Playwright suite; the Test Engineer owns that. Listing/counting only.
- Do not start any packet implementation.

DELIVERABLE
One final answer, under ~1200 words, structured as:
A. GO / NO-GO per host (Windows worktree gates, Linux capture host, Android build) with the blocking reason if NO-GO.
B. Exact Linux capture-host command sequence for G0, or the precise missing prerequisite.
C. W7 signing verdict: present / absent per required item (names only).
D. Per-packet gate host inventory + any unrunnable-as-written flags.
E. A11y and Playwright listed counts: real numbers vs plan numbers.
F. Blockers classified `in-scope` (fixable inside allowed files) vs `out-of-scope` (needs owner decision, credential, or scope change).
G. What you could NOT check and why.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA FOR YOUR REPORT
Every factual claim is backed by a command you actually ran plus its output, or an exact file path and line. Where you could not verify, write "not checked" - never infer. No secret values anywhere in your answer. Explicitly include: conclusions, work actually completed, evidence, uncovered scope, and blockers.
